desc: Test citizen login via 10-digit mobile number and 6-digit OTP
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
scenario: Verify citizen receives SMS OTP and successful verification returns JWT session token
steps: Navigate to MeeSeva DQMS login screen
Login screen opens with Citizen tab active
Enter 10-digit mobile number and click Get OTP
6-digit OTP generated and dispatched via SMS
Enter 123456 in OTP field and click Verify
Check redirection to Citizen Service Hub
Citizen Portal opens with service selection form

desc: Test citizen dashboard real-time statistics and queue metrics
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
scenario: Verify dashboard aggregates and displays active tickets, estimated wait times, and open counters
steps: Navigate to Citizen Dashboard from main menu
Verify active ticket and wait time cards
Active tickets (18) and wait time (12 min) render
Most recent citizen tokens listed with timestamps

desc: Test cascading selection across 33 districts and 5 major departments
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
test_data: District = Hyderabad, Dept = Revenue, Service = Income Cert
scenario: Verify selecting a district dynamically loads corresponding offices and departments
steps: Offices located in Hyderabad populate in dropdown
Revenue department services (Income, Caste, RoR) populate

desc: Test atomic sequence allocation for virtual queue token
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
scenario: Verify booking generates unique alphanumeric token ID using database sequence without collision
steps: Token format strictly matches prefix (e.g., REV-005)

desc: Test digital queue receipt and optical barcode pass rendering
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
scenario: Verify digital pass contains citizen details, token number, QR/barcode, and print button
steps: Open issued digital queue ticket pass
Optical barcode SVG displays clearly with token text
Receipt downloads as printable PDF pass

desc: Test government official login with *.gov.in email and role resolution
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
scenario: Verify officer login resolves jurisdiction and counter assignment strictly server-side
steps: Select Authorized Official tab on login gateway
Enter official email and request OTP
Official account recognized in Oracle DB
Enter OTP and click Access Command Center
Verify desk counter assignment in header

desc: Test counter operator atomically summoning lowest waiting ticket
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
scenario: Verify operator clicking 'Call Next' atomically claims the next waiting ticket in FIFO order
steps: Operator opens Command Center desk view
Active waiting list shows tickets REV-005, REV-006
Lowest waiting ticket (REV-005) assigned to Counter 01
Verify ticket status change in database
Ticket status changes from WAITING to CALLED in DB

desc: Test Server-Sent Events push broadcasting and procedural chime
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
test_data: Protocol = SSE (HTTP/2), Audio = Web Audio API
scenario: Verify calling a ticket pushes real-time event to citizen screens and plays 3-tone chime
steps: Citizen views active digital ticket screen
SSE broadcast event TICKET_CALLED received in <200ms
Procedural Web Audio API chime plays audibly
Screen displays prominent banner 'Proceed to Counter 01'

desc: Test ticket progression from CALLED to SERVING to COMPLETED
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
scenario: Verify operator starting service records start time, and completing service records end time
steps: Ticket status transitions to SERVING in DB
Transaction recorded with total service duration in audit log

desc: Test placing citizen ticket on hold when documents are missing
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
scenario: Verify operator can place citizen on hold, proceed with next citizen, and recall held citizen
steps: Operator clicks 'Put on Hold' on desk console
Ticket moves to HOLD status; counter becomes free
REV-006 is called and served without blockage
Citizen returns with documents; operator recalls
REV-005 reinstated to active serving at Counter 01

desc: Test automatic no-show flagging after 3 audible calls without arrival
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
scenario: Verify ticket is marked as NO_SHOW if citizen fails to report after 3 calls
steps: Chime plays; call count increments to 2
Citizen does not appear; operator clicks 'No-Show'
Ticket moves to NO_SHOW; counter becomes ready

desc: Test AI Sahayak chatbot providing civic service document checklists
prereq: Access to Chrome Browser / MeeSeva DQMS live instance
test_data: Query = 'What documents are needed for Income Certificate?'
scenario: Verify AI Sahayak returns accurate document checklists and fee schedules in English and Telugu
steps: Open AI Sahayak widget on Citizen Portal
Lists Ration Card, Aadhaar, Salary Certificate, Rs. 45 fee
